bounded_excerpts: He took Indra's office and claimed the powers and duties held by the gods of fire, wind, moon, waters and the other regions of the world.
A lion tore free of the bonds and sprang toward Devi.
They pierced his defense and broke sword and shield.
Before he could rise fully into another form, Devi ended the struggle with one stroke.
